```{r color-histogram}
#bin 1 is 0–0.125, bin 2 is 0.125–0.25, and so on
breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 9)  #8 bins

color_features <- df |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    r_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("r_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts),
    g_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("g_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts),
    b_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("b_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(r_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  unnest_wider(g_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  unnest_wider(b_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(filename, label, starts_with("r_bins"), starts_with("g_bins"), starts_with("b_bins"))
# Condenses to 24 numerical columns per image
```

```{r prior-specification}
# Use color histogram features (24 cols) not raw pixels
feat_cols <- setdiff(names(color_features), c("filename", "label"))

# Pull histogram rows using same split indices from train-test-split
train_df <- color_features[split_idx, ]
test_df  <- color_features[-split_idx, ]

class_counts <- table(train_df$label)
class_priors <- class_counts / sum(class_counts)
cat("Class priors:\n"); print(class_priors)

#Normalizing each color bin separately. Ie if red total count is 130, and one bin has 20 then we get a value of 20/130 for that bin.
normalise_hist <- function(df, feature_cols) {
  df_norm <- df

  r_cols <- grep("^r_bins", feature_cols, value = TRUE)
  g_cols <- grep("^g_bins", feature_cols, value = TRUE)
  b_cols <- grep("^b_bins", feature_cols, value = TRUE)

  for (cols in list(r_cols, g_cols, b_cols)) {
    chunk    <- as.matrix(df[, cols])
    row_sums <- rowSums(chunk)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1 #No div by 0
    df_norm[, cols] <- chunk / row_sums
  }
  df_norm
}
#Post normalization
train_df <- normalise_hist(train_df, feat_cols)
test_df  <- normalise_hist(test_df,  feat_cols)

cat("Number of features:", length(feat_cols), "\n")
cat("Normalised feature range: [",
    round(min(as.matrix(train_df[, feat_cols])), 4), ",",
    round(max(as.matrix(train_df[, feat_cols])), 4), "]\n")
#Expect mean roughly centered at .5 via beta, gamma for tau demonstarates we are uncertain
a_mu  <- 2;  b_mu  <- 2
a_tau <- 2;  b_tau <- 1
# Using log to avoid multiplication
log_prior <- function(mu, tau) {
  if (mu <= 0 || mu >= 1 || tau <= 0) return(-Inf)
  dbeta(mu,   a_mu,  b_mu,  log = TRUE) +
  dgamma(tau, a_tau, b_tau, log = TRUE)
}
#Gaussian stdev 1/sqrt(tau)
#Mult with log becomes addition
log_likelihood_feat <- function(x, mu, tau) {
  sum(dnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = 1 / sqrt(tau), log = TRUE))
}

log_posterior_feat <- function(x, mu, tau) {
  log_likelihood_feat(x, mu, tau) + log_prior(mu, tau)
}
```
```{r model-fitting}
mh_sampler <- function(x, n_iter = 2000, burnin = 500, thin = 5,
                       prop_sd_mu = 0.01, prop_sd_tau = 0.1) {
  mu_cur  <- mean(x)
  tau_cur <- 1 / var(x)
  if (!is.finite(tau_cur)) tau_cur <- 1 #Set to one if var(x) = 0(all vals same)
  mu_cur <- min(max(mu_cur, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6) #prevent mu from hitting 1 and 0 for beta issues

  samples <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_iter, ncol = 2,
                    dimnames = list(NULL, c("mu", "tau")))
  lp_cur <- log_posterior_feat(x, mu_cur, tau_cur)

  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    mu_prop  <- mu_cur  + rnorm(1, 0, prop_sd_mu)
    tau_prop <- tau_cur * exp(rnorm(1, 0, prop_sd_tau))
    lp_prop  <- log_posterior_feat(x, mu_prop, tau_prop)

    if (is.finite(lp_prop) && is.finite(lp_cur)) {
      log_accept <- lp_prop - lp_cur + log(tau_prop) - log(tau_cur) #Check if value shows improvement ie positive result(won't be finite if nt)
      if (is.finite(log_accept) && log(runif(1)) < log_accept) {
        mu_cur  <- mu_prop
        tau_cur <- tau_prop
        lp_cur  <- lp_prop
      }
    }#Record regardless accept/reject proposed
    samples[i, ] <- c(mu_cur, tau_cur)
  }
  keep_idx <- seq(burnin + 1, n_iter, by = thin)
  samples[keep_idx, ]
}

set.seed(42)
cat("Running MCMC...\n")

compute_posterior_samples <- function(df_train, feature_cols, class_priors) {
  classes   <- names(class_priors)
  all_samps <- list()
  total     <- length(feature_cols) * length(classes)
  done      <- 0

  for (cl in classes) {
    subset <- df_train |>
      filter(as.character(label) == as.character(cl)) |>  # safe string match
      select(all_of(feature_cols)) |>
      as.matrix()

    all_samps[[cl]] <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(subset)), function(j) {
      done <<- done + 1
      cat(sprintf("\r  Chain %d / %d", done, total))
      flush.console()
      mh_sampler(subset[, j])
    })
  }
  cat("\n")
  all_samps
}

posterior_samples <- compute_posterior_samples(train_df, feat_cols, class_priors)
#Feature 1 class 0/non-contaminated
samp0 <- posterior_samples[["0"]][[1]]
cat("\nPosterior samples shape:", dim(samp0), "\n")
cat("Posterior mean mu  (feature 1, class 0):", round(mean(samp0[,"mu"]),  4), "\n")
cat("Posterior mean tau (feature 1, class 0):", round(mean(samp0[,"tau"]), 4), "\n")
#Each loop s becomes new row of values
log_predictive <- function(x_new, samples) {
  log_liks <- apply(samples, 1, function(s) {
    dnorm(x_new, mean = s["mu"], sd = 1 / sqrt(s["tau"]), log = TRUE)
  })
  max_ll <- max(log_liks)
  max_ll + log(mean(exp(log_liks - max_ll)))
}

predict_one <- function(obs, posterior_samples, class_priors) {
  log_posteriors <- sapply(names(class_priors), function(cl) {
    samps   <- posterior_samples[[cl]]
    log_lik <- sum(mapply(log_predictive, obs, samps))
    log(class_priors[cl]) + log_lik
  })
  as.integer(names(which.max(log_posteriors)))
}
#predicts for each row in the DF
predict_bayes <- function(df_new, feature_cols, posterior_samples, class_priors) {
  X <- as.matrix(df_new[, feature_cols])
  apply(X, 1, predict_one,
        posterior_samples = posterior_samples,
        class_priors      = class_priors)
}

test_preds <- predict_bayes(test_df, feat_cols, posterior_samples, class_priors)
cat("\nPredictions (first 10):", test_preds[1:10], "\n")
cat("Actual     (first 10):", test_df$label[1:10], "\n")
```

```{r mcmc-diagnostics, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Pick 3 most discriminative features by posterior mean difference
mu0 <- sapply(posterior_samples[["0"]], function(s) mean(s[, "mu"]))
mu1 <- sapply(posterior_samples[["1"]], function(s) mean(s[, "mu"]))
diff_mu <- abs(mu0 - mu1)
diag_features <- order(diff_mu, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]

cat("Most discriminative features:", diag_features, "\n")
cat("Corresponding feature names:", feat_cols[diag_features], "\n")
cat("Posterior mean differences:", round(diff_mu[diag_features], 5), "\n")
for (fi in diag_features) {
  plot_list <- list()

  for (cl in c("0", "1")) {
    s <- posterior_samples[[cl]][[fi]]
    df_s <- data.frame(
      iteration = seq_len(nrow(s)),
      mu        = s[, "mu"],
      tau       = s[, "tau"]
    )

    # Trace mu
    plot_list[[paste0(cl, "_trace_mu")]] <- ggplot(df_s, aes(x = iteration, y = mu)) +
      geom_line(colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.4) +
      labs(title = paste0("Trace mu | class ", cl, " feat ", fi),
           x = "iteration", y = "mu") +
      theme_minimal()

    # Trace tau
    plot_list[[paste0(cl, "_trace_tau")]] <- ggplot(df_s, aes(x = iteration, y = tau)) +
      geom_line(colour = "orange", linewidth = 0.4) +
      labs(title = paste0("Trace tau | class ", cl, " feat ", fi),
           x = "iteration", y = "tau") +
      theme_minimal()

    # ACF mu
    acf_mu <- acf(s[, "mu"], plot = FALSE)
    df_acf_mu <- data.frame(lag = acf_mu$lag[-1], acf = acf_mu$acf[-1])
    plot_list[[paste0(cl, "_acf_mu")]] <- ggplot(df_acf_mu, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96 / sqrt(nrow(s)), linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -1.96 / sqrt(nrow(s)), linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray") +
      labs(title = paste0("ACF mu | class ", cl, " feat ", fi),
           x = "lag", y = "acf") +
      theme_minimal()

    # ACF tau
    acf_tau <- acf(s[, "tau"], plot = FALSE)
    df_acf_tau <- data.frame(lag = acf_tau$lag[-1], acf = acf_tau$acf[-1])
    plot_list[[paste0(cl, "_acf_tau")]] <- ggplot(df_acf_tau, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
      geom_col(fill = "orange", width = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.96 / sqrt(nrow(s)), linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -1.96 / sqrt(nrow(s)), linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray") +
      labs(title = paste0("ACF tau | class ", cl, " feat ", fi),
           x = "lag", y = "acf") +
      theme_minimal()
  }

  # Print one 2x4 grid per feature
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 4,
                          top = paste("Feature", fi))
}
```

```{r validation}
actuals <- test_df$label
classes <- sort(unique(actuals))

conf_mat <- table(Predicted = test_preds, Actual = actuals)
cat("Confusion matrix:\n"); print(conf_mat)

compute_metrics <- function(conf_mat, classes) {
  metrics <- lapply(as.character(classes), function(cl) {
    TP <- conf_mat[cl, cl]
    FP <- sum(conf_mat[cl, ]) - TP
    FN <- sum(conf_mat[, cl]) - TP
    TN <- sum(conf_mat) - TP - FP - FN

    precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FP)
    recall    <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FN)
    f1        <- if ((precision + recall) == 0) 0 else
                   2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
    list(class = cl, TP = TP, FP = FP, FN = FN, TN = TN,
         precision = precision, recall = recall, f1 = f1)
  })
  bind_rows(lapply(metrics, as.data.frame))
}

metrics_df <- compute_metrics(conf_mat, classes)
cat("\nPer-class metrics:\n")
print(metrics_df |> select(class, precision, recall, f1) |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))))

overall_accuracy <- sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
macro_precision  <- mean(metrics_df$precision)
macro_recall     <- mean(metrics_df$recall)
macro_f1         <- mean(metrics_df$f1)

cat(sprintf("\nOverall accuracy : %.4f\n", overall_accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Macro precision  : %.4f\n", macro_precision))
cat(sprintf("Macro recall     : %.4f\n", macro_recall))
cat(sprintf("Macro F1         : %.4f\n", macro_f1))

ggplot(as.data.frame(conf_mat), aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgreen", high = "forestgreen") +
  labs(title = "Confusion matrix", fill = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```
